subject: dplyr, do , lm giving me empty lists.

messages.author: f8151fe12a4e4b33
messages.subject: dplyr, do , lm giving me empty lists.
parts:
Hi
I'm having difficulty using the dplyr do() function. I am closely following the help(do) example but each attempt using the in-built hflights data gives me a 0 length list. I jumped to the assumption that it was a problem with NA but now with the code below--  I don't think so. Here is what I have tried. NB Although tho si slightly different from the example(do),  that fails too on the similar last couple of lines.

# version 1.0 updated ~ Dec 26th
library(dplyr)

# this works
lm(Distance~AirTime, data=hflights, na.action="na.exclude")
Call:
  lm(formula = Distance ~ AirTime, data = hflights, na.action = "na.exclude")
Coefficients:
  (Intercept)      AirTime  
-64.983        7.904

# with and without NA
carriers <- group_by(hflights, UniqueCarrier)
carriers.complete=group_by(hflights[complete.cases(hflights),], UniqueCarrier)

group_size(carriers)
[1]    79 73053  4648  2139   838  2204 45343  4082  2072 16061  2641 70032   695   365  3244

group_size(carriers.complete)
 [1]    78 71669  4504  2111   832  2121 44536  4030  2033 15781  2591 69373   673   364  3178


# all give 0 length lists
do(carriers, failwith(NULL, lm), formula = Distance ~ AirTime)
list()
do(carriers.complete, failwith(NULL, lm), formula = Distance ~ AirTime)
list()
do(carriers, failwith(NULL, lm), formula = Distance ~ AirTime, na.action="na.exclude")
list()
do(carriers, lm, formula = Distance ~ AirTime, na.action="na.exclude")
list()

# these are last couple of lines of example(do)
mods <- do(carriers, failwith(NULL, lm), formula = ArrDelay ~ date)
sapply(mods, coef)
list()

Ooops, looks like a bug. I'll fix it and push shortly.

I should note that do() is still rather experimental, but I'm planning
to work on it a lot for the next release.

Hadley
